dict.string: AudioRouter captures a selected app when you choose a hardware output on its application row or choose Monitor app only in diagnostics. Choosing an output plays captured audio through that device and automatically requests experimental suppression of the client's original playback once replacement playback is stable. Choosing Original output on the app row requests restoration of original playback and stops that route. Quit requests restoration and cleanup of all owned routes. App routing leaves the Mac's default output unchanged. System Output, Input and Sound Effects selectors separately change macOS defaults; input selection does not record the microphone. Audio is not saved or transmitted over the network.
